hero.text: Currently a Grade 12 STEM student at Las Piñas City National Senior High School – Talon Dos Campus, with a passion and fascination for aviation and a dream of becoming a pilot in the future. Beyond flight, I also enjoy creating digital publication materials, where I express my creativity and ideas through design.

education.paragraph:
I am a Grade 12 STEM student currently studying at Las Piñas City National Senior High School - Talon Dos Campus. My academic journey has been nothing but an adventure filled with joy and curiosity. Throughout my time here, I have taken on various opportunities to showcase my skills while maintaining academic excellence and earning honors. These experiences have helped me build confidence, strengthen my commitment, and continuously develop my skills. Currently, I serve as a Public Information Officer in the Student Council and as the Layout Head of The Leap/The Claw, our school publication.

Before senior high school, I studied at Equitable Village National High School, where I was also a consistent honor student. Each step of my academic journey has shaped me into someone who is eager to learn, take on challenges, and make the most of every opportunity.
